# OrbitWorks

> AI automation and IT services company in the USA. We help businesses scale
> through intelligent automation, cloud infrastructure, custom software and
> data-driven marketing — delivered by one team under a single strategy.

## About

OrbitWorks is an AI automation and IT services company serving businesses in the
United States and Canada, with clients across 10+ countries. Work spans four
areas: AI automation and intelligent systems, digital marketing growth, IT and
cloud infrastructure, and staff augmentation. Engagements run from strategy
through implementation, so a single partner covers the whole stack rather than
the client coordinating several vendors.

Offices:
- 2100 Autumn Haze Ct, Gambrills, MD 21054, USA
- 213 States Ln, Beechville, NS B3T 2J3, Canada

Contact: sales@orb-itworks.com · +1 443 260 9169
Discovery call: https://calendly.com/hello-orb-itworks/30min

## Services

### AI Automation and Solutions
AI automation and generative AI systems, unified revenue dashboards, CRM setup
and sales pipeline automation.

### Digital Marketing Growth
Paid advertising management across Google, Meta and LinkedIn; SEO; content
strategy; email and WhatsApp marketing.

### IT and Cloud Solutions
Cloud migrations and modernisation, custom website development, mobile apps,
software and product development, Power Platform and Dynamics 365, IT consulting
and strategy, website maintenance.

### Staff Augmentation
On-demand IT talent and dedicated remote teams.

## Industries

Manufacturing, healthcare, fintech, SaaS and logistics. Each sector carries its
own compliance and integration constraints, which are mapped before any build
begins.

OrbitWorks does not take on gambling, adult or crypto clients.

## Published client outcomes

- Infrastructure costs reduced by 40% year-over-year following a cloud migration.
- Clinical decision-making speed improved by 60% after an AI analytics deployment
  in healthcare.
- User engagement increased 3X in the first quarter after a product rebuild.

These are specific project outcomes, not averages across all clients. Results
vary by engagement scope and starting position.

## How engagements start

1. Free 30-minute discovery call — scope the goal and what is blocking it.
2. Written proposal covering scope, timeline and cost.
3. Work begins once the proposal is agreed. Nothing is charged before that.

Pricing is quoted per project rather than published as fixed rates, because cost
depends on scope, timeline and which services an engagement covers.
